class.name: DSPkg
class.brief_description: Builds and reads archives of DirectStorage texture payloads.
class.description: [DSPkg] packages existing [code].dstex[/code] files into a [code].dspkg[/code] archive without recompressing their payloads. Supports version 1, version 2, version 3, and version 4 archives. Version 2 archives store per-entry GPU mip metadata ([code]DSPkgMipEntry[/code]), enabling direct GPU streaming and hardware decompression from package files into VRAM. Version 3 archives store 32-bit per-entry flags ([code]flags[/code]), preserving [code]is_srgb[/code] and [code]as_image_texture[/code] attributes across archive roundtrips. Version 4 archives support table-of-contents (TOC) structure encryption and Poly1305 authentication. Encrypted archives carry their key as the PCK entry [code]res://.dspkg/toc.key[/code]: 48 bytes made of a 16-byte derived magic followed by the 32-byte key. [method open] reads and validates that entry itself, so a shipped game does not need to install a key. [method set_global_encryption_key] exists for editor previews and test tooling; it is not part of the shipped runtime path. Every build of this extension exposes all 20 [DSPkg] bindings, in the editor, in debug, and in release; no build strips the archive builder or the key helpers. Both GDeflate codec classes are registered in every build as well. Use [method create], [method add_texture], and [method finalize] to build an archive. Use [method open] and the reader methods to inspect or extract entry data. The resource loader also uses [code]res://textures.dspkg[/code] for bundled texture lookups.

method.name: add_texture
method.description: Adds an existing [code].dstex[/code] file to an archive currently being built. [param mip_metadata] can provide per-mip footprint metadata ([code]mip_sizes[/code], [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code], [code]mip_row_pitches[/code]) for GPU mip metadata archive generation; if empty, metadata is read automatically from the source [code].dstex[/code] file. Call [method create] first. Only the file's header and mip table are read here; the payload stays on disk and is streamed by [method finalize], which re-stats the file and aborts if it changed in between. Version 3 sources are accepted when they carry inline GDeflate payloads (their logical dimensions are staged for the v5 entry extension); version 3 Zstd/GACL/chunked payloads are refused. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if not building, [constant ERR_CANT_OPEN] if [param dstex_path] cannot be opened or its header cannot be read, [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if a version 3 source uses payload features the v4 archive cannot represent, or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] if the file's mip table does not match its declared mip count, if [param mip_metadata] contradicts the file's mip sizes, or if a size total overflows.

method.name: compute_key_id
method.description: Computes the 16-hex-character key fingerprint (BLAKE2b-64) for a 64-hex-character encryption key. Returns an empty string if the key is invalid.

method.name: create
method.description: Starts building a new archive at [param output_path]. [param archive_fingerprint] is the archive id written into the header; pass the same value to [method open] to bind the archive to one build. The default [code]0[/code] writes an unpaired archive, which a build publishing a non-zero [code]directstorage/export/archive_id[/code] rejects at open time, so an archive meant for distribution must be created with the same id the export publishes. Call [method add_texture] for each entry, then call [method finalize].

method.name: finalize
method.description: Writes the archive header, entry table, and staged payloads as a version 4 archive, or version 5 when an entry needs an entry extension (currently only the NPOT logical-size record); [code]min_reader_version[/code] matches the emitted version, so older readers refuse the file. If entries have GPU mip metadata, writes [code]DSPkgMipEntry[/code] tables. Each entry also serializes 32-bit entry flags (such as sRGB and ImageTexture compatibility). Returns [constant OK] on success; [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if not building or if no entries were staged; [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if two staged entries share the same resource path; [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if a resource path exceeds 65535 bytes, if an entry table, TOC, offset, or mip span overflows or cannot be aligned, or if bin-packing is enabled and the TOC envelope does not fit in the first 1 MiB chunk; [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] if staged mip metadata disagrees with the declared mip count or compressed sizes, if the TOC buffer serializes short or payload offsets are not monotonic, or if a mip slice exceeds the staged data; [constant ERR_CANT_CREATE] if a 16-byte archive salt could not be generated; [constant ERR_FILE_CORRUPT] if the encrypted TOC envelope is smaller than the entry table; or the value of [method FileAccess.get_open_error] ([constant ERR_CANT_OPEN], [constant ERR_FILE_CANT_WRITE], or [constant ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION]) if the output file cannot be opened for writing. [constant ERR_FILE_CANT_WRITE] is also returned when a header, padding or payload write fails (for example on a full disk) or when the finished file does not reach the computed size; every failure after [param output_path] has been opened closes the file and deletes the partial archive, including a staged source that was removed, replaced or resized after [method add_texture]. A truncated archive is never left behind, and a pre-existing file at [param output_path] is left untouched when the call aborts before opening it.

method.name: get_archive_fingerprint
method.description: Returns the 64-bit archive id embedded in the opened archive's header, or [code]0[/code] if no archive is open or the archive was written with pairing disabled.

method.name: get_entries
method.description: Returns an array of resource paths for all entries in the opened archive, or an empty array when no archive is open.

method.name: get_entry_count
method.description: Returns the number of entries in the opened archive.

method.name: get_entry_info
method.description: Returns metadata for an entry, including [code]archive_path[/code] ([String]), [code]path[/code] ([String]), [code]data_offset[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]original_size[/code] ([int]), [code]width[/code] ([int]), [code]height[/code] ([int]), [code]pixel_format[/code] ([int]), [code]mip_count[/code] ([int]), [code]flags[/code] ([int]), [code]has_gpu_metadata[/code] ([bool]), [code]is_srgb[/code] ([bool]), [code]as_image_texture[/code] ([bool]), [code]mip_offsets[/code] ([PackedInt64Array]), [code]mip_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), and [code]mip_row_pitches[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]).

method.name: get_global_encryption_key_id
method.description: Returns the 16-hex-character fingerprint of the key currently installed in this process: the override installed by [method set_global_encryption_key], or the archive key committed by a successful [method open]. A keyed source build with no override reports its baked key id; a keyless build with no committed key returns an empty string.

method.name: get_mip_entries_for_offset
method.description: Returns an array of [Dictionary] records representing the GPU mip entries located at absolute payload [param offset]. Each dictionary contains [code]offset[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]uncompressed_size[/code] ([int]), and [code]row_pitch[/code] ([int]). Returns an empty array if no mip entries match the offset or if no archive is open.

method.name: get_payload_alignment
method.description: Returns the payload byte alignment configured for the archive builder (default is [code]512[/code]).

method.name: has_texture
method.description: Returns whether the opened archive contains [param resource_path].

method.name: is_bin_packing_enabled
method.description: Returns whether 1 MiB chunk bin-packing is enabled for payload alignment.

method.name: is_payload_dedup_enabled
method.description: Returns whether identical-source payload deduplication is enabled for the archive builder.

method.name: is_repack_uncompressed
method.description: Returns whether [method finalize] repacks GDeflate-compressed [code].dstex[/code] payloads into uncompressed [code]NONE[/code] entries.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens and validates a [code].dspkg[/code] archive (version 1, version 2, version 3, or version 4) for reading. For encrypted archives (v4) the reader acquires the key itself from the PCK entry [code]res://.dspkg/toc.key[/code] and installs it only after the candidate reproduces the header's key id and decrypts the table of contents; a missing or wrong key returns [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED] and leaves any previously installed key untouched. If [param expected_fingerprint] is non-zero, opening fails with [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] unless the archive's embedded archive id matches it exactly; an archive that carries id [code]0[/code] is rejected, so a zeroed header id cannot satisfy a build that expects a real id. Passing [code]0[/code] as [param expected_fingerprint] skips the check and is intended for local tooling only. A truncated or malformed header or table of contents returns [constant ERR_FILE_CORRUPT]. A failed open clears any previously loaded archive state. Returns the error reported by [method FileAccess.get_open_error] (for example [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND], [constant ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION], or [constant ERR_CANT_OPEN]) if the archive file cannot be opened for reading.

method.name: read_texture
method.description: Reads an entry's compressed payload and metadata. The result contains [code]path[/code] ([String]), [code]compressed_data[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]width[/code] ([int]), [code]height[/code] ([int]), [code]pixel_format[/code] ([int]), [code]mip_count[/code] ([int]), [code]original_size[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]has_gpu_metadata[/code] ([bool]), [code]mip_offsets[/code] ([PackedInt64Array]), [code]mip_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), and [code]mip_row_pitches[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]). When [code]has_gpu_metadata[/code] is [code]true[/code], [code]mip_data[/code] ([Array] of [PackedByteArray]) is also provided containing individual mip slices.

method.name: set_archive_fingerprint
method.description: Sets or overrides the 64-bit validation fingerprint written into the archive header during [method finalize]. Must be called while building an archive.

method.name: set_bin_packing_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables 1 MiB chunk bin-packing when [method set_payload_alignment] is set to 1 MiB. When enabled, multiple small textures are packed into the same 1 MiB chunk with 512-byte GPU alignment, only inserting 1 MiB padding when a texture would cross a chunk boundary.

method.name: set_encryption_key
method.description: Configures the 64-hex-character symmetric encryption key for the archive currently being built (builder-only; returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] otherwise). Passing an empty string or "disabled"/"none" disables encryption. Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] on invalid input (previous key state is preserved). Warning: Storing plaintext keys in export preset configuration files risks exposing secrets if committed to source control.

method.name: set_global_encryption_key
method.description: Installs a process-wide override key for tooling: editor previews, probes, and test harnesses that open an archive they just produced. This is not part of the shipped runtime path — [method open] already reads the key from [code]res://.dspkg/toc.key[/code]. Passing an empty string clears the override and returns to the default resolution (PCK entry, or the compile-time baked key in a source build that has one); "disabled"/"none" explicitly disables decryption. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. Warning: Storing plaintext keys in export preset configuration files risks exposing secrets if committed to source control.

method.name: set_payload_alignment
method.description: Sets the payload byte alignment for archive entries. Must be a power of two and >= [code]512[/code]. For SteamPipe delta patching, pass [code]1048576[/code] (1 MiB).

method.name: set_payload_dedup_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables deduplicating identical [code].dstex[/code] payloads across alias entries (such as a source [code].png[/code] path and its imported [code].dstex[/code] path) during [method finalize]. Must be called while building an archive.

method.name: set_repack_uncompressed
method.description: Enables or disables export-time decompression of GDeflate-compressed [code].dstex[/code] payloads into uncompressed v5 [code]NONE[/code] entries during [method finalize]. Must be called while building an archive.
